name: StandBy
compactDescription: A PWA to replicate Apple's StandBy feature.
fullDescription: StandBy is a PWA that is meant to replicate Apple's StandBy feature, allowing a modular way to make widgets. While still incomplete, it allows you to select different panels on the left and right by cycling through. Future updates will include being able to change the colors of each widget individually, and possibly with an ability to have a single widget mode, allowing you to have just one enlarged panel on the screen as opposed to two.

name: Imagiline
compactDescription: A PWA to line up a previously taken image.
fullDescription: Imagiline is a PWA that lets you overlay a previously taken image onto your camera feed, allowing you to line up your camera with the same location the image was previously taken in. There are options to rotate camera, upload an image, change the opacity, and to show a 3x3 grid.

name: UniCalc
fullDescription:
UniCalc is (an upcoming PWA) calculator, as well as a converter. The idea stems from first, making a concept calculator app from late 2021, while trying to make a Neumorphic style calculator. In November of 2025 I had restarted the design to focus on consistency and concentricity, but was only design and no actual numbers were inputted on the concept.
At the beginning of 2026, I decided to actually make another shot at this design, and ended up with a functionally easy to use calculator design, reminicent of iOS devices. It follows better form, and has slightly better designs, and ended up having potential for many conversion types.

Well, the event is tomorrow! Based on what gets announced, I'll make a concept UI, or replicate one from the event. For now, this is the final idea I had for this. 

Also yes, I did have a fun birthday.

name: FaceMe
compactDescription: A PWA to talk to friends, face to face.
fullDescription: FaceMe is a PWA that allows you to video call friends and family. With a simple backend, just connecting two people via their adresses, allowing them to call and connect directly without any middleman to transfer data. FaceMe allows you to start a call with a custom username, and room ID (numbers and/or letters), and make a room. The other person puts in the same room ID, and joins. You get choose your camera, mute your microphone.

name: MultiPlay
fullDescription: MultiPlay is a conceptual univeral music player connecting Spotify, Apple Music, Youtube Music, Soundcloud, etc. Into one app. The design features a clean layout and accessible buttons for navigation between songs, and the queue.

name: FrameSeeker
compactDescription: A PWA to view and save frames of a video.
fullDescription:
FrameSeeker is a site that allows you to save a full quality image of a specific frame in a given video. This was actually made to help me get clean and uninterrupted images from Apple events and keynotes at precise timestamps.
The PWA allows you to upload a video (even using share targets on mobile or desktop) and capture a full quality image at a given frame. You are able to set the framerate of the video, jump to a certain frame (based on the framerate), set playback speed to 0.5x, 1x, 2x, and 4x, as well as full screen the video, or fit the video to show the ambient adaptive background. On newer devices and on desktop, you can also set the save folder to save all your images to a given location locally, so the images don't all end up in your downloads folder. There are a handful of utility buttons to skip 15 seconds, 1 second, and go one frame at a time forwards and backwards.

name: Songify
fullDescription:
In collaboration with Frank Richter, Muhammad Harrie, and Naeem Mohaidheen, in our Sophmore Project class at the end of 2025, we have designed and developed a swipe based, song searching and filtering algorithm that allows a user to find songs based on what they like and dislike, and even favorite/super like songs that they love most. With the ability to see songs that the user has liked, and allowing them to catagorize searches and libraries, this song finding algorithm enables easier search of songs without needing to hassle through forums and verbal reccomendations. 
 Frontend design and development was directed by myself, and researched and developed by all of us.

name: TimeBreak
compactDescription: A PWA to see what time to take a break.
fullDescription: TimeBreak is a site that allows you to see what time to take a break based on your work schedule. It is a simple PWA that allows you to input your shift start and end, and break length and get a suggested break time. You can also save times and load them for quick access. Also, you can view the length of your shift.

I always had the idea for iPhones without the dynamic island, to incorporate all the live activities into the home bar instead. Possibly good, possibly bad, not sure but 100% a concept for now. The concept falls short for if a user wants to actually use the home bar. Also, in iOS 26, the home bar was removed/hidden, so this concept is now out of date.

name: Colorizer
compactDescription: A PWA to fullscreen any color you want.
fullDescription:
Colorizer is a site that allows you to show any color across the entirety of your screen. I wanted to have an underglow lighting on a model iPhone 16, but I did not have a colored lightbox, so I made this app to use my s11 ultra tablet as a underglow for the device.
This PWA allows you to choose a color either in hex, hsl, hsv, or rgb, and save colors for later use. The color gets fullscreened, and on tapping empty space, the menu dissapears, and can reappear with one tap.
